blend_two_poses: blend two motion poses together using slerp and lerp interpolation with a configurable alpha weight
stitch_two_motions: stitch two motion sequences together with pivot alignment and overlapping blend for smooth transitions
append_motion_sequences: append a second motion sequence to a first one with optional pivot alignment and blending
transform_motion: apply a 4x4 transformation matrix to all poses in a motion sequence with an optional pivot frame
cut_motion_range: cut a motion sequence to return only poses within a specified frame start and end range
